fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Room and tax only, up to $640

Booking a room for someone else at the Harbor Inn starts with one link. The cardholder names the guest and chooses what the card covers: room and tax for two nights, capped at $640. Incidentals stay with the guest. The front desk sees the signed authorization on the reservation before check-in.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Retainers go through on the 1st without a phone call

Clients of Ledgerline Bookkeeping sign once for a $1,500 monthly retainer and save a card in Stripe. Each card is charged on the 1st, and the charge is logged under that client's authorization. When a card declines, the account manager gets a Slack message with the client's name and the amount due.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
The rep never hears the card number

Phone orders at Copper Kettle Roasters end with an email instead of digits read aloud. The rep enters the order, and the buyer authorizes a one-time charge of $2,340 from a link on their phone. The rep sees only the card brand and last four digits. Once it is signed, the order goes to the warehouse.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { hotelStays: "I run the Harbor Inn and need a third-party credit card authorization form for people paying for someone else's room. Show the signed authorization on the reservation for the front desk.", monthlyRetainers: "My bookkeeping firm bills clients a $1,500 retainer every month. Build an authorization form where each client signs once and saves a card through Stripe. Charge every card on the 1st and log each charge under that client's authorization. If a card declines, send the account manager a Slack message with the client name and amount due.", noShowFees: "My physical therapy clinic needs a card on file at online booking. Patients accept our policy: missing a visit without 24 hours' notice costs $50. When the front desk marks a no-show, let them charge the $50 to the saved card with one click and email the patient a receipt that quotes the policy.", phoneOrders: "My coffee roastery takes large orders by phone. After the rep enters an order, email the buyer a link to authorize a one-time charge, for example $2,340, and enter the card on their phone through Stripe. Show the rep only the card brand and last four digits, and send the order to the warehouse once it is signed." };

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A table of monthly retainers charged on the 1st shows three paid and one declined card, and the account manager gets a Slack alert that Marlow Studio owes its $1,500 retainer.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A clinic front desk marks a missed visit as a no-show and charges the $50 fee to the patient's saved Mastercard, with the signed 24-hour policy shown on the record.
